PRICING_SUBTITLE: Choose what works best for you
FAQ_1_Q: What do I need to start?
FAQ_1_A: Just a computer or smartphone with internet connection! All materials are provided digitally. We use Zoom for online classes.
FAQ_2_Q: Can I join if I'm a complete beginner?
FAQ_2_A: Absolutely! We have dedicated A1 beginner groups. You'll start speaking from your first lesson with our supportive community.
FAQ_3_Q: What if I miss a class?
FAQ_3_A: All lessons are recorded and available in your personal dashboard. You can catch up anytime and reach out to your teacher with questions.
FAQ_4_A: It varies, but with regular practice (2-3 times per week), most students reach conversational fluency (B1) in 6-8 months. Our immersion programs can accelerate this significantly.
FAQ_5_A: Yes! If you're not satisfied after your first lesson, we offer a full refund. Your satisfaction is our priority.
FAQ_6_Q: Can I switch between group and private lessons?
FAQ_6_A: Of course! Many students combine both formats for optimal results. Contact us anytime to adjust your learning plan.
